entries.description: The Qdrant Docs MCP server endpoint (streamable HTTP) for searching and reading the Qdrant documentation, articles, blog, course, and code snippets from MCP clients. No sign-in required.
representativeQueries: search the Qdrant documentation from my coding agent
find a Qdrant code example for hybrid search in Python
look up how to configure quantization in Qdrant

entries.description: The Qdrant Cloud MCP server endpoint (streamable HTTP) for managing clusters, backups, serverless spaces, access, and billing in Qdrant Cloud from MCP clients. Signs in with OAuth or a Cloud API key.
representativeQueries: create a Qdrant Cloud cluster from my coding agent
check the health and metrics of my Qdrant Cloud cluster
back up my Qdrant Cloud cluster from an MCP client

entries.description: MCP Server Card for the hosted Qdrant Cloud MCP server: its registry name and streamable HTTP remote.
representativeQueries: find the Qdrant Cloud MCP server URL and transport
discover the Qdrant Cloud MCP server before connecting an MCP client

entries.description: OAuth protected-resource metadata for connecting clients to the Qdrant Cloud MCP server.

entries.description: Agent skills for building with, operating, and troubleshooting Qdrant.
